Model evaluation is a topic extensively covered elsewhere, so here we will highlight some of the tools available, and recent updates to the workflow.

## Leave-one-out cross-validation

Efficient approximate leave-one-out cross-validation is possible using Pareto smoothed
importance sampling.


::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## Python
```{python}
#| eval: false
az.loo()
```
## R
```{r}
#| eval: false

m1_loo <- loo(m1)
m2_loo <- loo(m2)

loo_compare(model1 = m1_loo, model2 = m2_loo)

```
:::
